summary: Son of William Wells II and Elizabeth Tuthill, born in 1690, and grandfather of Dr. Henry Wells; John's 1st cousin 10 times removed.
bio: Henry Wells was born on 7 February 1690, the son of William Wells II and Elizabeth Tuthill, which made him a grandson of both William Wells and the John Tuthill born in 1635. He was the father of Obadiah Wells (1716-1800) and the grandfather of Dr. Henry Wells. Through both his parents he was John's 1st cousin 10 times removed, though this identification is only possible rather than proven.
sources: [R4-S1] Charles W. Hayes, William Wells of Southold and his Descendants (1878) (archive.org full text), ch. VI-VII (secondary) https://archive.org/details/williamwellsofso00byuhaye
